title: QMNF Proof Hole Resolution
main_goal: Close all 13 sorries/admits in QMNF formal proofs
context: QMNF integer-only arithmetic, coprime moduli, K-Elimination and ResidueLearning theorems

nodes.label: Modular Inverse Existence Lemma
nodes.statement: For coprime M, A with A > 0: exists M_inv such that (M * M_inv) % A = 1

artifacts.result_md: FIXED: Changed A > 0 to A > 1. Removed unreachable case. Simplified proof.
artifacts.critic_md: MAJOR issue resolved. Statement now requires A > 1.

nodes.fix_applied: Changed hA : A > 0 to hA : A > 1, removed by_cases branch, updated call site

nodes.label: CRT Uniqueness Theorem
nodes.statement: For X,Y in [0, M*A) with coprime M,A: (X%M = Y%M and X%A = Y%A) implies X = Y

artifacts.result_md: COMPLETE: Case analysis X<=Y vs Y<X. Uses Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd, interval_cases for k=0.

proof_strategy: Case split: X <= Y or Y < X

nodes.label: K Bounded Lemma
nodes.statement: For X < M*A and M > 0: X/M < A

artifacts.critic_md: MINOR: Unused hM hypothesis, implicit A > 0. VERIFIED.

nodes.label: K-Elimination Main Theorem
nodes.statement: k = ((X%A + A - X%M) * M_inv) % A where M_inv is modular inverse of M mod A

artifacts.result_md: COMPLETE: Uses mod_inverse_exists (D001), k_bounded (D003). Case split on r >= v_M handles natural subtraction. Inverse cancellation gives exact k.

proof_insights: Uses +A to handle natural subtraction (avoids truncation to zero)
Case split on r >= v_M vs r < v_M for borrow handling
M*M_inv = 1 mod A cancels to give exact k

artifacts.critic_md: MINOR: Corrected theorem has proper structure. Issues: dimension factor handling, original still broken, helper sorries need completion.

critique_issues: Dimension factor: helpers have n*G^2 but final theorem has G^2
Original theorem still broken (uses t=0 with sorry)
recommendations: Add hG_dim hypothesis to absorb dimension factor

nodes.label: Exact Arithmetic Preservation
nodes.statement: All intermediate values in modular GD remain exactly representable in RNS

artifacts.critic_md: MAJOR: Bound inconsistency - Conclusion 1 uses <M but CRT uniqueness requires <M/2. Conclusion 2 NOT PROVABLE as stated.

CRITICAL: Conclusion 2 is NOT PROVABLE as stated (|x-y| < 2M not M)
